notes.title: Sato's Report: IPU ☆Coming Soon☆ Development Update!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171361/a604b6770cba33270e52decc96a1703a5db38f24.png"]



Hello, Sir!

This is Sato, your loyal secretary from Cheese Burger Studio!

Thanks for waiting so long!

Strange beings have appeared all over the world! (Emergency!!)


So our team has been super busy dealing with them!

Some of you might’ve faced off against Sister Emily in the demo.


But to purify even more of these mysterious creatures, our Hunter Smith needs to grow stronger—with your help, of course! 😆


We’re working hard to make your hunts smoother and more thrilling.

Great news is on the way! 💓


We’ve listened to your feedback from the demo and made major balance updates to IPU.

(I tagged along for a hunt myself—and wow, it was fun! lol)


Here are the exciting new features:


1. Account Skill Shop (Managed by Mr. Stan)  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171361/963680932c68ae0d9a06bfe98e9af164e15cb5fe.png"]

2. Weapon Shop (Managed by Miss. Lee)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171361/fe9c1d7eb8abb3bd1a734db08766ddc8ac332ed1.png"]



That’s all for today’s Sato Report!

See you soon with more updates!
